concerns.text: Task T011 implements an elemental property loader but no corresponding verification task (e.g., T011_verify) is defined to check that `DataHygieneError` is raised and that no external API calls are made.
Task T012 (descriptor calculator) lacks a verification task to ensure that melting‑temperature variance is output and that the task aborts when input lacks melting temperatures.
Task T013 (composition filter) has no verification step to confirm that entries with missing elemental properties are correctly excluded.
Task T014 (pipeline orchestrator) does not have an associated verification task to assert correct sequencing and proper propagation of the `SUCCESS`/`NO_DATA` status.
Task T030 (run power analysis) delegates to T145 but lacks its own verification task (e.g., T030_verify) to confirm that `output/power_analysis.json` is created and conforms to its schema.
Task T2000 (comprehensive verification script) is defined without a corresponding verification task; the pipeline needs a check that the script runs successfully and reports failures correctly.
Task T2001 (update README/quickstart) lacks a verification step to ensure the documentation reflects the current implementation.
Task T2002 (verify all FRs are covered) has no verification task; a check is needed to confirm that every functional requirement has at least one implementation task.
Task T2003 (generate pinned requirements.txt) is missing a verification task to validate the generated file against `requirements.schema.yaml`.
Task T2004 (CI workflow) does not have a verification task to assert that the CI run completes successfully and records status in `output/ci_status.json`.
Tasks T140 and T141 reference a Zenodo URL placeholder (`) instead of a concrete URL, making implementation ambiguous and non‑deterministic.
Task T145 is defined twice (once in Phase 0 and again in Phase 4). This duplication should be consolidated to avoid redundant work and potential inconsistencies.
